data.name: Deliver Us Home
data.detailed_description:
(Content on this page is still work-in-progress and changes over the course of development)

Quick facts

  • Deliver Us Home is a single player narrative-driven, third-person adventure game set in a futuristic (wide linear) world that’s yours to explore, traverse, survive, and uncover a spine-chilling plot that brought this planet to the end of humanity.

  • A solitary adventure fueled with unique and thrilling moments in memorable, awe-inspiring contrasted environments that blend abandoned space technology with historic original land.

  • Deliver Us Home is a new unique standalone experience but shares the universe of its predecessors and takes place around a 100 years later from the original games.

  • Be part of a series that uses the power and reach of the medium we love so much - games - to deliver meaningful messages in compelling, entertaining stories.

Secure a future for humanity.

It’s the 23rd century. Humanity has long ago evacuated the wasteland that is planet Earth. You, a descendant of the evacuees, sent out into the endless void of space, your mission statement is as simple as it is impossible: secure a new, permanent home for humanity.

You’ve prepared for the unexpected, the worst, and the most extreme conditions, there’s no telling what lies in store for you on the surface. Survive the unknown, explore the desolation, and break ground for humanity’s new home as you uncover the secrets of mysterious settlers that arrived here long before you did...

Explore and Scavenge

Deliver Us Home is filled with interactions used to explore the nooks and crannies of both your designated planet and outer space. Command your robot companion and drive your vehicles to reach areas otherwise inaccessible to you. Climb ledges, scale walls and move objects to platform your way to new heights and more mysteries.

Upgrade and Survive

Deliver Us Home contains adjustments and upgrades to your suit, robot companion and your vehicle to keep progressing and to style them to your taste. In classic Metroidvania fashion, you’ll find that some upgrades not only unlock completely new areas, but also allow you to access locations that were previously just beyond your reach.

Uncover and Restore

Deliver Us Home features a host of mysteries waiting for you to uncover them. As you find more information, clues, messages, holograms, logs, artifacts and more, the story carefully unfolds. Reconcile with your past, uncover the truth about the settlers who came before you, and ultimately restore your designated planet to secure a new home and future for humanity.

data.short_description: Deliver Us Home is a solitary sci-fi experience where one astronaut works to secure a home and new future for humanity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
